name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo discovered motorsport through his father, a mechanic for a local rally team. He was immediately captivated by the technical complexity and the relentless pursuit of performance. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from the Polytechnic University of Valencia, Ricardo started his career in Formula Student before transitioning to GT racing. He quickly gained a reputation for his methodical approach to problem-solving and his ability to optimize car setups for diverse track conditions.

Ricardo believes that a chief engineer's role is as much about people management as it is about technical expertise. He fosters a collaborative environment within his team, encouraging open communication and creative thinking. Known for his calm demeanor under pressure, he has a knack for making strategic decisions during critical moments of a race. His dedication to data analysis and relentless pursuit of improvement have made him a valuable asset to any team.

His distinctive trait is his ability to simplify complex technical concepts, making them accessible to the entire team, from drivers to mechanics, fostering a shared understanding and purpose.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches.
Has a particular fondness for strong espresso and drinks one every morning.
Taps his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
